title: Dalton Enterprises, Inc.: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (6 affected)
summary: Dalton Enterprises, Inc. (Dalton) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Adam J2040 trailers equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Elgin Sweeper Company: Fan Assembly may Separate from the Vehicle (120 affected)
summary: Elgin Sweeper Company, Inc. (Elgin Sweeper) is recalling certain 2018-2022 RegenX vehicles.  The fan assembly mounting bolts may have been improperly tightened.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: Tire Tread May Separate (173,237 affected)
summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (Goodyear) is recalling certain G159 tires, size 275/70R22.5 with DOT date codes 046 through 0403.  The tread may separate from the tire.

title: General Motors, LLC: Brake Fluid Reservoir Cap Missing Label/FMVSS 135 (237 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 Cadillac XT6 vehicles.  The brake fluid reservoir cap may be missing the warning label.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (56 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2020 ERA motorhomes, equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improperly Installed Steering Shaft Bolt (3,573 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2023 Freightliner M2, 108SD, and 114SD vehicles.  The u-joint pinch bolt on the steering shaft may become detached, which can cause a loss of steering control.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Swing Up Table Could Drop Unexpectedly (168 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 East to West Alta and Palomino SolAire travel trailers equipped with a swing up table/bed base.  The base may have incomplete welds that are unable to hold the intended weight, causing the table/bed base to drop unexpectedly.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Bracket May Interfere with Seat Belt Pretensioner (3 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2017-2018 G5 school buses equipped with an elevated floor and electrically adjustable driver's seat.  An incorrect bracket may have been installed on the driver's seat and may interfere with the seat belt pretensioner.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: Incorrect Front Brake Rotor/FMVSS 122 (1,923 affected)
summary: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. (KMC) is recalling certain 2020-2021 LX230A and 2022 LX230G motorcycles.  The incorrect front brake rotor may have been installed, which can reduce brake performance.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 122, "Motorcycle Brake Systems."

title: C.E. Smith Company, Inc.: Axle Weld may Fail Allowing Wheel to Separate (2,043 affected)
summary: C.E. Smith Company, Inc. (C.E. Smith) is recalling certain 2021-2022 C.E. Smith Company Multi-Sport 48810 and 48815, Multi-Sport Plus 48870, Malone Auto Racks MicroSport MPG460, and EcoLight MPG585 boat trailers. The weld connecting the axle tube to the wheel spindle may fail, causing the wheel to separate from the trailer.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (1,779 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2022-2023 VN tractor trailers.  The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: Off Grid Trailers: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (300 affected)
summary: Off Grid Trailers (Off Grid) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Expedition, Pando, and Switchback travel trailers equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (5,644 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2021-22 Granite, Anthem, LR, Pinnacle, and Terrapro tractor trailers. The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: Clek, Inc.: Installation Diagram Missing/FMVSS 213 (11,123 affected)
summary: Clek, Inc. (Clek) is recalling certain Olli booster seats, model number OL12U2 manufactured between January 20, 2020 and May 10, 2022, and Ozzi booster seats, model number OZ11U2, manufactured between March 1, 2020 and May 10, 2022.  The installation diagram displaying the proper way to install the booster seat with a continuous-loop lap/shoulder belt is missing.  As such, these child seats fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Keystone Coachworks Inc: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (4 affected)
summary: Keystone Coachworks Inc (Keystone Coachworks) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Mercedes-Benz Metris Custom Camper Vans equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Zero Motorcycles Inc.: Incorrect Front Brake Caliper Bolts (23 affected)
summary: Zero Motorcycles Inc. (Zero) is recalling certain 2022 SR and SR/F motorcycles.  Incorrect front brake caliper bolts may have been installed and could damage the mounting threads on the fork, causing the caliper to loosen.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Vehicle Display Malfunction/FMVSS 111 (12,490 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Taycan vehicles.  A software error could cause the center screen (including rearview camera image) and the touch control panel remain to black directly after the ignition is activated.  Also, the Real-Top-View (including rearview camera image) could display a flickering image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Steering Gear Incorrectly Assembled (5,768 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Freightliner (FCCC) MT45, MT45G and 2022-2023 Freightliner Cascadia vehicles.  The steering gears may have been incorrectly assembled, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Vehicle Rollaway Due to ABS Malfunction (206,502 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Dodge Durango vehicles.  A malfunction in the antilock-brake system (ABS) module may illuminate the brake lights, and allow the vehicle to start and shift out of Park without the brake pedal being applied.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump Failure (27,794 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar High Pressure Fuel Pump part numbers: 68211268AA, 68211269AA and Mopar 3.0L Diesel Engine part numbers: 05158019AK, 05158036AF, 05158048AC, 05158048AD, 05158048AE, 05158048AF, 05158052AD, 05158052AF, 05158052AG, 05162072AD, 05162072AE.  A high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) failure may introduce internal debris into the fuel system, potentially resulting in fuel starvation.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump Failure (138,645 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2014-2020 Jeep Grand Cherokee, and 2014-2019 Ram 1500 vehicles equipped with 3.0L diesel engines.  A high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) failure may introduce internal debris into the fuel system, potentially resulting in fuel starvation.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (117,413 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Ram 1500, 2500 pickup trucks, and 3500 Cab Chassis vehicles with GVWR less than 10,000 lbs.  The radio software may prevent the rearview image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Roush CleanTech, LLC: Corrosion May Cause Fuel Line Leak (8,385 affected)
summary: Roush Cleantech, LLC (Roush) is recalling certain fuel return lines included in GEN 4 and GEN 5 LPG Conversion Systems that were installed on vehicles sold or registered in Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Washington D.C., West Virginia, and Wisconsin.  The zinc-plating on the fuel return line may break away when contacted by road debris, causing two dissimilar metals on the fuel line to contact each other and corrode.

title: Roush CleanTech, LLC: Corrosion May Cause Fuel Line Leak (3,285 affected)
summary: Roush CleanTech, LLC (Roush) is recalling certain altered 2016-2022 Ford E350, E450, F450, F550, F53, F59, F650 and F750 trucks that were sold, or registered in Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Washington D.C., West Virginia, and Wisconsin.  The zinc-plating on the fuel return line may break away when contacted by road debris, causing two dissimilar metals on the fuel line to contact each other and corrode.

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Loss of Vehicle Lighting (22 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Inferno and Igniter vehicles.  An additional resistor was incorrectly installed on the printed circuit board, which can disrupt CAN network communication and cause vehicle lighting to fail.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Step Treads Inadequately Secured to Step Brackets (607 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 Prime Time Crusader and Sanibel fifth wheel travel trailers.  The step treads are inadequately secured to the step brackets.

title: Ford Motor Company: Instrument Panel Not Illuminated/FMVSS 101 (30,467 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Transit vehicles.  The Instrument Panel Cluster may not properly illuminate telltales or gauges and the speedometer and tachometer pointers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays," and 102, "Trans Shift Lever Seq/Starter Interlock/Trans Braking Effect," and 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems," and 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Ford Motor Company: High Voltage Battery Contactor May Overheat (48,924 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Mustang Mach-E vehicles.  The high voltage battery main contactors may overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Child Safety Lock Malfunction (53,103 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain four-door 2021-2022 Bronco vehicles. The passenger-side rear door may be opened from inside of the vehicle when the child safety lock is in the "ON" position.

title: Ford Motor Company: Unintentional Rollaway Due to Detached Shift Cable (2,925,968 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2013-2019 Escape, 2013-2018 C-Max, 2013-2016 Fusion, 2013-2021 Transit Connect, and  2015-2018 Edge vehicles.  The bushing that attaches the shifter cable to the transmission may degrade or detach.

title: Ford Motor Company: Unsecured Fuel Tank Attachment Strap (1 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling one 2021 F-150 vehicle.  A single vehicle may have been assembled without a fuel tank front attachment resulting in an unsecured fuel tank attachment strap.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Radiator Fan Fuse May Short (273 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2021 LFS and 2019-2022 LFS Artic buses.  The radiator fan's electrical fuse holder may experience excessive corrosion which can result in an electrical short.

title: Shyft Group: Head Restraint Position Incorrect/FMVSS 202 (5,551 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft Group) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Utilimaster Walk-In Vans.  The headrest portion of the passenger-side jump seat may have been installed in an incorrect position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 202, "Head Restraints."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improperly Connected High Voltage Battery Cable (185 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2021-2023 FCCC Saf-T-Liner C2 Jouley Electric Buses.  A high voltage battery cable may not be properly connected, which can cause a loss of electrical power or a ground short circuit.

title: Kentucky Trailer Manufacturing: Walk Board Rack May Separate From Vehicle (2,944 affected)
summary: Kentucky Trailer Manufacturing (KTM) is recalling certain 2014-2021 Kentucky Trailer MV and PV vehicles.  The walk board rack mounting bolts may loosen, allowing the rack to separate from the vehicle.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Malfunctioning Hood Latch (322,671 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2013-2016 Pathfinder vehicles.  On certain Pathfinder vehicles, the secondary hood latch may malfunction and remain in the unlatched, unsecured, position when the hood is closed.

title: Kaufman Trailers Group, LLC.: Insufficient Welds On Ramp Holding Brackets (235 affected)
summary: Kaufman Trailers of NC, Inc. (Kaufman) is recalling certain 2018-2021 FXSG-10K-20D and FXSG-10KK-20D-SC trailers.  The welds on the ramp holding bracket may be insufficient.

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Malfunctioning Exterior Driver-Side Door Handle (21 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2022 Huracan EVO and STO vehicles.  The exterior driver-side door handle may not be assembled properly, which can prevent the opening of the driver-side door from the outside.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: ABS Telltale Not Enabled/FMVSS 105 (3 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2022 Kenworth T180 and 2023 Kenworth T280 and Peterbilt 535 vehicles.  The ABS telltale was not enabled on certain vehicles, and will not illuminate even during an ABS malfunction.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Transmission May Slip Into Unexpected Gear (402 affected)
summary: PACCAR, Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2022 Kenworth T180, 2021-2023 Kenworth T280, 2022-2023 Kenworth T380, 2022-2023 Peterbilt 536, and 537 vehicles.  Internal components of the transmission actuator may slip, causing the actuator to become miscalibrated.

title: General Motors, LLC: Rear Suspension Toe Link May Separate (736 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 Cadillac XT5, XT6, and GMC Acadia vehicles.  The left-rear suspension toe link may have been tightened improperly, which could result in a loose or separated toe link.

title: International Motors, LLC: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (33,655 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2022-2023 International HX, HV, LoneStar, LT, MV, RH, IC TC Commercial Bus, and  2022 International WorkStar vehicles.  The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: International Motors, LLC: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (3,570 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2022-2023 IC CE School Buses.  The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Frame Corrosion May Cause Fuel Leak (132,882 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2006-2014 Ridgeline vehicles that were sold, or ever registered in Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Washington D.C., and Wisconsin.  An accumulation of road salt may cause the frame mounting surface, where the fuel tank mounting bands are attached, to corrode and possibly detach the fuel tank, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Irbit Motorworks of America, Inc.: Wheel Lock-Up From Improperly Tightened Spokes (3,250 affected)
summary: Irbit Motorworks of America, Inc. (Irbit) is recalling certain 2012-2017 Ural Gear Up, Ural Patrol (T), Ural Retro, 2012-2015 Ural Tourist (T), and 2015-2017 Ural cT motorcycles.  The wheel spokes may have been improperly tightened, which can damage the rims or cause a wheel lock-up.

title: Cruiser RV: Cracked LP Gas Quick Disconnect Fitting (2,985 affected)
summary: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain 2022 Shadow Cruiser, Embrace, MPG, Radiance, Hitch, Twilight, and Stryker travel trailers.  The quick disconnect fittings in the LP gas system may be cracked, causing a gas leak.

title: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC: Cracked LP Gas Quick Disconnect Fitting (12,285 affected)
summary: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2022 Cyclone, Gravity, Sundance, Big Country, Big Horn, Big Horn Traveler, Elkridge, Fuel, North Trail, Landmark, Lithium, Milestone, Torque, Trail Runner, Pioneer, Prowler, and Road Warrior travel trailers.  The quick disconnect fittings in the LP gas system may be cracked, causing a gas leak.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Oil Pressure Sensor Incorrectly Wired (974 affected)
summary: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc. (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2022 NQR Gas and NRR Gas trucks equipped with 6.0L engines.  The engine wiring harness assembly was incorrectly wired to the oil pressure sensor.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (1 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova) is recalling a single Sheppard model steering gear: M110P Part Number: N34355. The steering gear may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.

title: Triple E Recreational Vehicles: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (371 affected)
summary: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Unity U24MB, U24IB, U24CB, U24FX, U24RL, U24TB, and Wonder W24MB, W24RTB, W24FTB, W24RL recreational vehicles, equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Gillig, LLC: EV System May Switch into Neutral Unexpectedly (169 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Low Floor electric transit buses.  The EV resolver cable connector may experience a loss of electrical connectivity, unexpectedly switching from Drive to Neutral with no warning.

title: Autocar, LLC: External Fuse Box May Short Circuit (2,143 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Xpeditor (ACX) trucks.  The external fuse box may short circuit due to water intrusion.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Unexpected Engine Shut Down (461 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Thomas Built C2 Saf-T-Liner school buses equipped with 8.8L LPG engines.  The engine control module (ECM) may set a fault code that results in an unexpected engine shut down.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Unexpected Engine Shut Down (258 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2019-2022 FCCC S2G and 2023 Thomas Built Buses Saf-T-Liner C2 vehicles equipped with 8.8L LPG engines.  The engine control module (ECM) may set a fault code that results in an unexpected engine shut down.

title: BorgWarner: Stuck EGR Valve May Cause Loss of Drive Power (2,217 affected)
summary: BorgWarner is recalling certain Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valves with part numbers LX6E 9D475 AB and 05281255AK.  The washer inside the EGR valve may come loose and cause the valve to stick open, resulting in an unexpected loss of drive power.

title: Fabform Industries, INC.: Trailer Utility Gate May Detach (1,515 affected)
summary: Fabform Industries, INC. (Fabform) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Versatile FLR-D, FLRR-D, and DBX trailers.  The rubber stop on the utility gate may break, and allow the gate to detach from the trailer.

title: Proterra Operating Company, Inc.: Improperly Connected High Voltage Battery Cable (185 affected)
summary: Proterra Operation Company, Inc. (Proterra) is recalling certain High Voltage Junction Box (HVJB) DC Links, with part number 051071.  A high voltage battery cable may not be properly connected, which can cause a loss of electrical power or a ground short circuit.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Insufficient Number of Emergency Exits/FMVSS 217 (3 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2023 Thomas Built Saf-T-Liner C2 School Buses.  The buses may not have a sufficient number of emergency exits.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Dexter Axle Company: Hub May Separate from Axle Wheel End (2,926 affected)
summary: Dexter Axle Company (Dexter Axle) is recalling certain 42mm Cartridge Bearing Washers, part number 005-147-01.  The 42mm cartridge bearing washer within the hub assembly may crack, causing the hub to separate from the axle wheel end.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: 110-Volt Power Supply May Overheat Causing a Fire (165 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2022 Momentum travel trailers.  The 110-volt power supply wire was incorrectly wired directly into the solar inverter, which can overload the circuit and cause the power supply wire to overheat.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Emergency Braking System May Not Engage (17 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022 Freightliner Cascadia vehicles.  The emergency braking system may not engage, resulting in the loss of braking ability.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Engine Stall From Ignition Timing Software Error (1,740 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co) is recalling certain 2020-2022 GL1800 Gold Wing motorcycles equipped with manual transmissions.  An ignition timing software error for the engine control unit (ECU) may reduce engine performance, which can result in an engine stall.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Wheel May Detach From Vehicle (661 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023 Subaru Solterra and Toyota BZ4X vehicles.  The hub bolts on the wheels may loosen, causing a wheel to detach from the vehicle after low-mileage use.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Axle Shaft May Separate (46,176 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022 Tundra and Tundra Hybrid vehicles.  The flange nuts on the axle shaft sub-assemblies can loosen over time and potentially cause one or both axle shaft sub-assemblies to separate from the axle housing.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: Illegible Tire Date Code/FMVSS 119 (76 affected)
summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (Goodyear) is recalling certain Kelly Armorsteel KDM I tires, size 11R22.5 with DOT date code 3419.  The date code in the tire identification number (TIN) was incorrectly embossed on the tire, which may make it illegible.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 119, "New Pneumatic Tires-Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: General Motors, LLC: Fuel Tank Rollover Valve May Not Properly Seal (228 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 Cadillac XT5, XT6, and GMC Acadia All-Wheel Drive (AWD) vehicles.  The fuel tank rollover valve may not provide a proper seal in the event of a rollover crash.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Seat Belt Pretensioners May Explode (17,199 affected)
summary: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Sorento Hybrid and 2022 Sorento Plug-in Hybrid vehicles.  In the event of a crash, the front driver-side and/or passenger-side seat belt pretensioner(s) may explode upon deployment.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Incorrect Axle Spindle Nuts Installed (9 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2023 Champion Dry Van trailers.  The incorrect axle spindle nuts may have been installed, which could result in bearing failure.

title: Ford Motor Company: Side Marker and Daytime Running Lights May Fail/FMVSS 108 (965 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Lincoln Navigator vehicles.  The headlight control module software may cause the side marker and daytime running lights to fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Axle Rating on Federal Placard/Part 567 (205 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 RPOD RPT153 travel trailers.  The Federal Placard states an incorrect axle rating of 4400 lbs, instead of the correct rating of 3500 lbs, which can cause the vehicle to become overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Ford Motor Company: Inadequate Front Windshield Bonding/FMVSS 212 (63,294 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Bronco and Ranger vehicles.  The windshield may not have been properly bonded to the vehicle, which could allow it to detach during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 212, "Windshield Mounting."

title: Airstream, Inc.: Hub May Separate from Axle Wheel End (224 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2022 Caravel, Flying Cloud, Globetrotter, International and Pottery Barn travel trailers.  The 42mm cartridge bearing washer within the hub assembly may crack, causing the hub to separate from the axle wheel end.

title: Ford Motor Company: TPMS Light May Not Illuminate/FMVSS 138 (2,666 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 F-150 BEV vehicles equipped with 20" or 22" all season tires.  The tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) light may not illuminate as intended, failing to warn the driver of low tire pressure.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Rails Improperly Heat-Treated/FMVSS 208 (776 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Lincoln Aviator and Ford Explorer vehicles.  The engine rails may have been improperly heat-treated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 301, "Fuel System Integrity."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: ABS Fault Codes Not Stored/FMVSS 121 (17 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022 Freightliner Cascadia vehicles.  The Anti-lock Brake System (ABS) fault codes will not be stored when the vehicle is keyed off for more than 5 seconds, impairing its diagnostic features and warning light.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Unsecured Transmission May Cause Rollaway (180,176 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Frontier and Titan vehicles.  The transmission parking pawl may not engage when the vehicle is shifted into park, which can result in a vehicle rollaway.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Seat Belt Pretensioners May Explode (72,142 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Venue vehicles.  In the event of a crash, the front driver-side and/or passenger-side seat belt pretensioners may explode upon deployment.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Power Relay Under Rear Seat May Cause Fire (10,575 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Ioniq HEV and Ionic PHV vehicles previously recalled under recall number 18V-704.  The Power Relay Assembly (PRA) located underneath the rear seat may overheat.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Vehicle Rollaway from Unsecured Electronic Axle (25 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022-2023 FCCC MT50e walk-in vans.  The electronic axle parking pawl may be broken or damaged which, when in park without the emergency brake set, can result in vehicle rollaway.

title: Custom Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Steering Fasteners May Fail (1 affected)
summary: Custom Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Custom Fire) is recalling one 2018 Peterbilt 348 fire truck.  The Dana D-series axle steering arm fasteners that attach the steering arm to the steering knuckle may fail.

title: K.Z., Inc.: Incorrect Tire Information on Tire Placard (13 affected)
summary: KZRV, L.P. (KZRV) is recalling certain 2021 Escape travel trailers.  The tire placard states incorrect tire information, which can result in the tires being overinflated.

title: General Motors, LLC: Inoperative High-Mounted Brake Light/FMVSS 108 (242 affected)
summary: General Motors (GM) has decided that certain 2022 model year Chevrolet Silverado, and GMC Sierra vehicles equipped with an accessory sport bar.  The accessory sport bar contains a high-mounted brake light that may not function.  In addition, it may block the vehicle's existing high-mounted brake light.  As such, these vehicles may fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment."

title: General Motors, LLC: Loss of Power Brake Assist/FMVSS 135 (23,734 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2018-2020 Buick Regal vehicles.  In the event of a vacuum-power brake assist failure, a software error in the electronic brake control module (EBCM) may result in a loss of power brake assist.  As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 135, "Light vehicle brake systems."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Risk of Vehicle Rollaway/FMVSS 121 (17 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022 Freightliner Cascadia vehicles.  The electronic parking brake may not engage when the vehicle is keyed off, which may result in a vehicle rollaway.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 121, "Air Brake Systems," and 136, "Electronic Stability Control Systems on Heavy Vehicles."

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Inadequate Circuit Protection (430 affected)
summary: Altec Industries Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2016-2022 van mounted AT200A and AT30G vehicles.  The ground-fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) outlet may not provide adequate circuit protection against an electrical overload condition.
